reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by spartan (https://spartan.ng/).
Technology stack: angular, typescript, css.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏正中一句话很直白：Stop fighting your component library.，副标题写 Accessible UI primitives for Angular - built with signals, SSR compatible, zoneless ready. Install the behavior. Copy the styles. Customize without limits.，下面三颗按钮是 Get Started、View Components、Star on GitHub。再往下换到 Examples 一排标签，Dashboard、Tasks、Playground、Authentication 横排，展示区里铺开 Payment Method 卡片、Two-factor authentication 卡片、Compute Environment 里的 Kubernetes 与 Virtual Machine 选项。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
